Method of Attack: Ransomware attacks with data theft using a zero-day vulnerability in the MOVEit Transfer security file transfer platform
Data extortion by listing victim companies on a data leak site to pressure ransom payment
Discoverer: Rewards for Justice (RFJ) program, U.S. State Department
Impacted Systems: U.S. federal agencies including The Department of Energy
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in MOVEit Transfer file transfer platform
Indicators of Compromise: Data leak site operated by Clop ransomware gang
Tor SecureDrop server for submitting tips on Clop and other threat actors
